title: Client Dashboard Sprint
subtitle: Your data is in a file. The client QBR is tomorrow. Build a live interactive dashboard instead of sending another deck.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.display_name: Meridian Retail Group — Q4 FY2024 Data
data_files.role: 4 sheets: Revenue Summary (scorecard + regions + product mix), Monthly Revenue (Jan–Dec), Client Risk Table (10 clients, renewal risk), Pipeline (Q1 2025 forecast)

learning_objectives: Attach a data file to your AI and let it read every number — your job is context and judgment, not data lookup
Write the five things a spreadsheet cannot tell an AI: who is in the room, what story the data tells, which number is the hero, and what action is required
Specify animations and interactivity in a prompt so your first build already has the wow layer — not as an afterthought
Iterate with precision: name the single most important gap in your first output and fix only that in one follow-up
Deliver a self-contained HTML dashboard with working animations that opens in any browser — no install, no server, no dependencies
